limitations.SAVED_METADATA_ONLY: Relationships come from saved citation metadata. A missing link does not mean the sources are unrelated.

admin.title: Title
admin.author: Author
admin.footerTagline: EvidencePilot Admin v2.4.1. Crafted for academic excellence and data integrity.
admin.usersSub: Manage institutional access and user permissions across the Evidence Pilot ecosystem.
admin.projectsSub: Central terminal for managing all active and archived academic research initiatives.
admin.papersSub: Manage and monitor research paper progress across all active projects.
admin.auditSub: Review system activities and security events across the platform.
admin.healthSub: Real-time infrastructure monitoring and resource allocation.
admin.queueSub: Monitor and manage the document data extraction pipeline.
admin.broadcastSub: Send system-wide announcements or targeted messages to your research groups. Messages will appear in the user's notification center and as in-app banners.
admin.collectionsSub: Manage and organize research data clusters across your organization.
admin.settingsSub: Configure application parameters, categories, and review deployment variables.
admin.guideDashDesc: Overview of the platform at a glance.
admin.guideDashUsers: Total registered users broken down by role.
admin.guideDashProjects: Active projects with categories and collections.
admin.guideDashDocuments: Total active documents including source files and paper docs.
admin.guideDashOverviewProjects: Active projects now live here, next to Collections in the Platform Overview panel.
admin.guideDashStatus: User status breakdown: active vs banned accounts.
admin.guideUsersDesc: User management: create, ban, reset password, or delete accounts.
admin.guideUsersCreate: Create one Student or Instructor. The temporary password comes from the email.
admin.guideUsersImport: Upload one JSON file containing up to 200 users of one role.
admin.guideUsersTable: Lists users with email, name, student code, immutable role, status, and actions.
admin.guideUsersActions: Ban/activate, reset password, or delete a user.
admin.guidePapersDesc: Paper pipeline overview. Each card represents a stage.
admin.guidePapersFlow: Drafts → Submitted → In Review → Published → Rejected. Shows paper flow through the system.
admin.guidePapersCount: Total paper documents and source files in the system.
admin.guideAuditDesc: Audit trail of all system activities.
admin.guideAuditFilter: Filter logs by entity type, such as USER, PROJECT, and DOCUMENT.
admin.guideAuditTable: Each row shows when, who, what action, which entity, and changed values.
admin.guideInfraServices: Each service shows online/offline status. Red indicates attention needed.
admin.guideInfraStorage: Storage usage bar. Monitor capacity to avoid service disruption.
admin.guideNotifForm: Type your message, select target role, and send. All users receive it in real-time.
admin.guideNotifHistory: Previously sent notifications appear here with timestamp and target role.
admin.guideSettingsForm: Configure application name and other system preferences.
admin.guideProjectsDesc: View and manage all projects in the system.
admin.guideProjectsTable: Each row shows project title, status, and creation date. Admins can delete projects.
admin.systemSettingsHint: Read-only. Values are injected via environment variables and cannot be modified through the UI.
admin.guideCategoriesDesc: Manage collection categories used to organize evidence collections.
admin.guideCategoriesList: List of all categories. Each shows name, description, and active status.
admin.guideCategoriesForm: Add or edit a category. Name is required, description is optional.
admin.guideConfigTable: Each row shows a setting name and its current value. Loaded at startup.
admin.guideQueueDesc: Monitor document extraction progress and retry failed jobs.
admin.guideQueueCards: Summary cards show counts per processing status.
admin.guideQueueFailed: List of failed documents. Click Retry to re-queue.
admin.guideHistoryDesc: View past broadcast notifications sent to users.
admin.guideHistoryTable: Each entry shows message, target role, recipient count, and sent time.
admin.guideCollectionsTable: List of collections with instructor email and source count.
admin.searchUsers: Search by email, name, or student code...
